Browser-local Simple Test Case Builder with Markdown export
Guide hub plus reproducible test repositories and fixtures

informationArchitecture.job: Understand the offer and open one useful developer or SEO tool immediately
Browse all maintained browser-local mini tools by user job
Clean and deduplicate keyword lists before import, clustering, or tracking
Validate and normalize URL lists before a crawl or import
Check which pasted robots.txt rule applies to one crawler and path
Review a title and meta description in a search-result-style preview
Find structural errors in an MCP JSON-RPC payload or tool definition
Format, validate, or minify JSON without uploading it
Generate and copy one or more UUID v4 values
Create a SHA-256 digest and optional portable receipt for normalized text
Create a compact Markdown test case from one action and expected result
Choose the method or evidence collection needed after a tool result
Practice identifying programming languages from syntax clues
Inspect executable evidence behind selected tool claims
Understand the separation from the former newsletter and audience and the owner-approved indexable launch

operatingModel.burden: medium for the current maintained set; high if expansion toward 50 tools outpaces testing, sources, and landing-page maintenance
operatingModel.cadence: Release small categorized batches only after each tool, landing page, primary references, limits, mobile flow, and browser-local privacy behavior pass QA
operatingModel.stopCondition: Indexing was explicitly approved by Matthias Ramahi on 28 August 2026 while independent technical review and former-operator or mark clearance remain disclosed as not proven. Stop adding tools when existing utilities are stale, overlapping, untested, or lack a distinct user job. Park or reduce the site to the maintained evergreen set if recurring use does not justify the operating burden.

days30: Hold the nine shipped tools stable after launch and collect privacy-approved usage evidence only after a separate analytics decision
Complete former-operator and mark due diligence without changing the newly authored identity boundary
Obtain a qualifying independent technical reviewer and retain the public not-independently-reviewed disclosure until then
days60: Improve the strongest utilities from observed failure cases and real user feedback
Choose the next small SEO or developer-tool batch from distinct user jobs rather than keyword fan-out
Keep guides, quiz, methodology, and field tests as secondary paths
days90: Review direct use, return use, maintenance burden, source freshness, and workflow continuation
Choose a maintained nine-tool library, a justified expanded batch, or a reduced evergreen set
Review Search Console discovery and query evidence without promising indexing or rankings
